verdict.rationale: Three of the four steps are well documented as programmatic SDK calls an agent can make on its own. getSandbox() gets or creates a sandbox by ID, sandbox.exec() runs commands and captures stdout, stderr and exit codes, and the code interpreter and readFile() return results. Teardown is the weak link: the pack has no documented destroy or delete call, a community user reports there is no idle auto-destroy so implementers must handle cleanup themselves, and another notes containers merely auto-shut-down when idle. Missing for 10: documented explicit sandbox teardown/destroy API, lifecycle and cleanup controls, and independent hands-on corroboration of the full unattended loop.
